_comment: Copy to bridge.json beside the exe. Only the payload path lives here - the gate config (tiers, cooloff, max loss, time window) is on the Auto Settings form, and order size is the main form's Amount box.
_comment_feedback_output_path: C1 v2 executor feedback (contract section 8) SHIPS OFF, so the key is DELIBERATELY ABSENT from this template - absent means fully inert: no timer, no worker, no file. To enable, add "feedback_output_path": "C:\\Dev\\DeribitBridge\\executor_feedback.json"; present-but-blank resolves to that same section-8.2 default. The path is not a credential and is logged at startup.
